prompt: A small electronics workshop has two technicians, Alex and Ben, who assemble circuit boards, and one dedicated tester. Alex can assemble a board in 10 minutes, and Ben can assemble a board in 15 minutes. They both work simultaneously for 3 hours each day. During the assembly process, 10% of the assembled boards are found to have manufacturing defects and are immediately set aside, never reaching the testing stage. The tester can process 15 good boards per hour. How many hours must the tester work to test all the *good* boards assembled by Alex and Ben during their 3-hour shift?
